entities.summary: Alonso Sánchez de Huelva was a 15th-century mariner and merchant born in Huelva, Spain, on Andalusia's Atlantic coast. He is believed to have been one of the first Europeans to circumnavigate the globe, reaching the Indian Ocean and establishing trade relationships with the Kingdom of Calicut in present-day India. This voyage, although not definitively proven, is thought to have occurred between 1436 and 1442, during which Sánchez de Huelva may have encountered the Chinese admiral Zheng He. The expedition's success would have had significant implications for the spice trade and European exploration, but the exact details of Sánchez de Huelva's journey remain shrouded in mystery. His legacy as a pioneering navigator and trader has been largely overshadowed by that of his contemporaries, but his achievements serve as a testament to the ingenuity and determination of early European explorers.
